# Agent Aquarium

> A free macOS screensaver and lock screen that shows what your AI coding agents (Claude Code) are doing while you're away. Your Mac stays locked; the screen shows each session's progress, which one needs you, an away message, your next meeting and your Claude plan usage.

- Website: https://agentaquarium.danamsalem.com
- Download (GitHub Releases): https://github.com/danamsalem/agent-aquarium/releases/latest
- Requirements: a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later), macOS 13 or later, and Claude Code
- Price: free. License: free to use, no redistribution or modification (https://agentaquarium.danamsalem.com/terms)
- Made by Dan Amsalem (https://x.com/dannamsalem), a personal project. Not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Google.

## Features

- Live agent status for every Claude Code session: working, done or waiting for you, with its task list
- Needs-you alerts: the screen glows when an agent waits for approval
- Away message with presets, in any language
- Calendar: current and next meeting from Google (read-only), Apple or Outlook
- Claude plan usage: 5-hour and weekly limits (Pro, Max and Team plans)
- Four themes: Aquarium, Warm, Retro pixel, Cosmic
- Menu bar fish with quick actions; optional keep-awake while agents work; save battery; always-on display for a second monitor
- Local and private: runs entirely on the Mac, no account, no tracking
